scenes.headline: How a small video model watches long clips for less
scenes.sub: VideoChat3's inflated 3D tokenizer, and frames that change resolution.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Tansy! VideoChat3 is a four-billion-parameter video model built for long clips. Here's how it keeps the tokens from exploding.

scenes.label: The trick
scenes.text: Compress at the tokenizer, but only after attending across four frames at once, so motion survives in the tokens that are kept.
scenes.say: Every frame is a few hundred tokens, so long video gets expensive. The fix: compress at the tokenizer, but only after the frames have looked at each other.

steps.say: Frames come in at their native resolution. Each is cut into patches and stamped with where it sits, and when.
Four frames at a time form a chunk, and attention runs across the whole chunk, so space and motion are modelled together.
Only then does it compress: pool the four frames into one in time, and merge two by two patches in space.
Four in time times four in space is sixteen times fewer tokens. Each slot still remembers what moved.

scenes.title: Resolution follows the stream's state
scenes.say: The second move sets each frame's cost by what is happening, not by the clock.

items.say: In silence, frames are seen at a low quota, two hundred and twenty-four pixels square.
When a standby cue fires, an answer is about to appear, so the next window is enlarged.
In response, frames get four hundred and forty-eight pixels square, roughly four times the tokens, to catch the detail.

scenes.title: Seconds for 2048 frames
scenes.note: same hardware, same clip, end to end
scenes.say: The payoff grows with length. On two thousand and forty-eight frames, it answers in about twenty seconds, against forty-four for Qwen3-VL.

scenes.text: Summarise each four-frame window after attention, and a small model can afford long video without losing motion.
scenes.say: Summarise each four-frame window after attention, and a small model can afford long video without losing the motion.

recap: Silence, Standby, Response set the resolution
scenes.say: To recap: attend, then pool sixteen times. Let the stream's state set the resolution. And long clips stay fast.
